name: whoop_hrv_drop
description: Latest HRV is more than 20 % below the 7-day mean.

query_condition.sql: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rk = 1 THEN hrv END) AS latest_hrv, AVG(hrv) AS mean_hrv FROM (SELECT score_hrv_rmssd_milli AS hrv, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY _timestamp DESC) AS rk FROM "whoop_recovery" WHERE score_state = 'SCORED') HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN rk = 1 THEN hrv END) < 0.8 * AVG(hrv)
